instruction: I am using Ubuntu. Could you help me set LibreOffice Calc as the default spreadsheet application?

metadata.explanation: Task variation that sets LibreOffice Calc as the default spreadsheet application. Uses custom getter get_default_spreadsheet_app__08e66955 which checks the application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet MIME type handler using xdg-mime query. Evaluates that the default spreadsheet app includes 'libreoffice-calc.desktop'.
metadata.verification: The getter queries the default handler for application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet MIME type using xdg-mime. The metric check_include_exclude verifies that 'libreoffice-calc.desktop' appears in the result, confirming LibreOffice Calc is set as the default spreadsheet application.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter uses correct MIME type (application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.spreadsheet) for spreadsheet files
Getter uses correct Linux command (xdg-mime query default) to query default application handler
Metric correctly verifies that result includes 'libreoffice-calc.desktop' which is the correct desktop file identifier
Expected value is semantically correct - 'libreoffice-calc.desktop' is the actual identifier returned by xdg-mime
Complete coverage - evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement
No state accessibility issues - default application setting is persistent system state requiring no UI dialogs or postconfig
Data flow is correct: getter extracts string -> metric searches for substring -> returns 1.0 if match found
Edge cases handled properly: returns 0.0 if app not set or different app is set
